messages:
samir: Quick heads-up 5: we keep getting cold starts in prod during unexpected spike windows. Need to tighten pool orchestration + autoscaler rules. Any quick wins?
clare: The autoscaler currently trusts two signals independently: tenant forecast + pool utilization. When both spike briefly we overprovision, when they diverge we underprovision.
jon: We also see allocation failures due to MIG fragmentation after scale-ups. New nodes come up but can't fit tenant slices. Causes 429/503s.
esra: Proposal: introduce a lightweight admission token for burst requests (signed by operator) and a separate prewarm scoring pipe for predictive actions. Keep admission O(1) local.
mara: For scoring, let's use a cheap heuristic: recent qps * SLA_weight / estimated_gpu_minutes. It avoids full ML forecasting and is explainable.
clare: Good. Also add a cost_budget cap per tenant for prewarm. If predicted prewarm cost exceeds cap, skip and route to lower-cost model variant.
jon: Implementation detail: tokens should carry a small bitfield: {tier, credits, pack_hint}. Pack_hint guides local allocator to prefer contiguous MIG slots.
esra: Token format sketch (signed, compact): \n```\nbase64(header).base64(payload).sig\npayload: tenant=acme;c=2;exp=1812354200;hint=contig\n```\nAgent verifies signature and decrements c atomically.
samir: Nice. On fragmentation detection: add a metric 'unallocatable_fraction' = unusable_gpu_minutes / total_gpu_minutes. If > 0.2 -> pause predictive prewarm and only allow emergency burst tokens.
clare: We need visibility: Console should show prewarm decisions, estimated token cost, and delta-to-baseline. That helps CS justify charges for dedicated pools.
mara: For credit allocation: baseline per tier + rolling earn-rate based on sustained QPS. Earned credits should decay (leaky bucket) to discourage gaming.
jon: Edge-case: noisy-tenants spike credits then drop. To avoid noise, only credit earn after sustained period > 5min.
esra: Also add an operator-level dry-run mode: given a trace replay, return the set of prewarm and token allocations and the hypothetical cost delta. Useful before enabling predictive for new customers.
samir: Testing plan: 1) sim harness on one-week trace from two customers, 2) run canary in staging with dry-run enabled for 24h, 3) flip predictive on with low score_threshold.
clare: Observability hooks: token_issued, token_consumed, token_rejected(reason), prewarm_scheduled(reason,score,cost_est). Emit tenant-tagged metrics.
jon: Admission shim prototype log example: \n```\n[admit-agent] ts=1812350001 tenant=acme token_ok=true credits_left=1 alloc_hint=contig admitted=true latency=18ms\n```\nesra: Failover policy: on admission failure (no token or no capacity) -> if compatible model variant exists, route there; else enqueue request with tenant-specific max_wait derived from SLA tier.
mara: For billing, record prewarm_gpu_seconds and map to tenant invoice line item. Also add an annotation if prewarm was triggered by predictive vs user-requested warm.
samir: Action items: esra draft compact token spec + signing keys (KMS integration); jon prototype local admission shim + alloc_hint plumbing; clare run sims and design score threshold; mara add billing hooks & dry-run UI; samir to update autoscaler feature flag and rollout plan.
orch-bot: deploy:autoscaler-v3 queued for canary. PR #4991.
samir: Thanks team 5:30 sync tomorrow to review canary metrics.
